entries.reason: v5 compares walked paths with a different prefix style than the embedded URLs, so a first rescan treats every indexed file as new. ClearCase matches by decoded path relative to the case folder, the key the import used, so an indexed original is never re-added. Evidence: tests/system/rescan.test.ts:161.

entries.reason: v5 collects size and date but never reports a change. ClearCase reports changed originals: a quick scan finds a size change, a full scan compares SHA-256 and finds a same-size change, and the result is listed. Parity sees the change: IDR-404. Evidence: tests/system/rescan.test.ts:82.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 rescan links use one relative base while the embedded document links use another, so one of them is wrong for any app location. ClearCase builds addition links with the same base and encoding as imported documents, and opens them through the document route. Evidence: src/lib/local-case/rescan/rescan.server.ts:197.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 numbers a new ref from the bundle row count without padding, so it can collide or misorder. ClearCase continues the highest number used per prefix (imported, rescan and cleared refs), zero-padded to the case width, and never issues a ref twice. Evidence: tests/system/rescan.test.ts:55.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 turns everything under the folder, including its own app page and generated output, into document rows. ClearCase skips hidden entries, processing package folders and its own data directory, and never writes output into the case folder; other loose files in the folder are still listed as additions. Evidence: tests/system/rescan.test.ts:143.

entries.reason: v5's Write updated index to file writes only the rescan additions, not a merged index. ClearCase keeps this: its download holds only the additions in v5's row shape. Writing a full updated index would need an app change. Evidence: src/lib/views/system/rescan.server.ts:64.

entries.reason: v5 marks non-PDF files as extracted although nothing was extracted, and detects invoices with a case-specific pattern. ClearCase marks every addition as pending processing and detects invoices by the generic word in the file name. Parity sees the change: IDR-403. Evidence: src/lib/local-case/rescan/rules.ts:10.

entries.reason: v5 swallows folder-picker cancel and permission errors silently. ClearCase needs no picker; a case folder that cannot be read, or a scan that fails, is reported on the page with the message and the statement that nothing was changed. Parity sees the change: IDR-401. Evidence: src/lib/views/system/rescan.server.ts:43.

entries.reason: v5's backup key list omits five live user-work stores, so their work is silently lost. ClearCase backs up every registered table and a test round-trips all 21 v5 stores, including those five, through backup and restore. Parity sees the change: IDR-413. Evidence: tests/system/stores-21.test.ts:134.

entries.reason: v5's key list names four keys no code reads or writes. ClearCase has no key list: it backs up registered tables, and keeps the four unused v5 keys only as documented legacy keys that a v5 backup import reports as unused. Evidence: tests/system/backup.test.ts:296.

entries.reason: v5 import has no validation or confirmation, so a parseable but wrong file overwrites stores. ClearCase checks format, checksum, case and size before any write, requires a confirmation tick, keeps a copy of the current work, and changes nothing on refusal. Parity sees the change: IDR-419. Evidence: tests/system/backup.test.ts:99.
